method_note: EUCASS 2025 (Rome, 30 Jun - 4 Jul 2025) published only a programme-at-a-glance (15 rooms x 7 presentations per slot, no session titles) and a DOI search listing 541 papers without track labels, so the previous edition was analysed: the joint 10th EUCASS / 9th CEAS conference (Lausanne, 9-13 Jul 2023). Counted 97 oral technical sessions with 472 timed presentations (talks marked 'Cancelled' excluded) from the official 'Technical Sessions detailed programme'; plenaries and posters excluded. Track names use the programme's symposium codes; the long names given here are descriptive expansions, not quoted from the site. Note that 2023 was a joint EUCASS-CEAS edition, which may overweight aeronautics compared with a standalone EUCASS. Each session = 1 unit split across at most 2 keywords. Keywords below 0.02 (ai-ml, control-theory, smallsat, education, osam, trajectory, space-policy, hri, avionics; together 0.103 of session-units) were dropped and the remaining weights renormalized to sum to 1.
